description: Test suite for stock ledger entry functionalities in ERPNext, including reposting, back-dated entries, and item valuation updates.

classes.name: TestStockLedgerEntry
classes.description: Test case class for stock ledger entry operations in ERPNext.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, creates items, and clears existing stock ledger entries and bins.

methods.name: test_item_cost_reposting
methods.description: Tests reposting of item costs through stock reconciliations, stock entries, and back-dated entries.

methods.name: test_purchase_return_valuation_reposting
methods.description: Verifies valuation updates during purchase return and landed cost voucher application.

methods.name: test_sales_return_valuation_reposting
methods.description: Checks valuation rate adjustments for sales returns, delivery notes, and landed costs.

methods.name: test_reposting_of_sales_return_for_packed_item
methods.description: Tests valuation rate updates for packed items and product bundles during sales return reposting.

methods.name: test_sub_contracted_item_costing
methods.description: Validates valuation of subcontracted items after applying landed costs and BOMs.

methods.name: test_back_dated_entry_not_allowed
methods.description: Ensures only authorized roles can create back-dated stock entries.
